title: The first dollar from your side hustle shouldn’t touch your checking

beats.say: The first dollar your side hustle earns should not touch your checking account.
beats.visual: extreme close-up of a $1 bill on a wet asphalt road, neon glow from a distant sign reflecting on the surface, low angle

beats.say: Mix it with paychecks, and come April, you’ll owe taxes on income you can’t even track.
beats.visual: silhouette of a person at a desk, backlit by a single desk lamp, papers and a laptop half-lit, rain streaking the window

beats.say: Why do most people still dump it all in one place?
beats.visual: empty office chair under cold fluorescent light, a single dollar bill on the seat, high angle shot

beats.say: They assume it’s easier. But mixed money means mixed headaches.
beats.visual: extreme wide shot of a city skyline at blue hour, a tiny human walking along a ridge line, fog rolling in

beats.say: Step one: open a free business checking account online today. Takes 5 minutes.
beats.visual: hands typing on a keyboard, screen blurred, sodium street light through blinds casting stripes

beats.say: Step two: auto-transfer every side-hustle dollar here the second it hits.
beats.visual: close-up of a phone screen with a banking app, shot from behind, finger tapping, background out of focus

beats.say: Step three: keep a simple spreadsheet. Date, amount, source. That’s it.
beats.visual: notebook on a wooden table, single practical light casting a sharp shadow, only the edge of the pen visible

beats.say: Now, what about taxes? One account means one ledger, one clean answer.
beats.visual: stack of tax forms under a flickering fluorescent light, shadow stretching across the floor

beats.say: An extra $1,000 a month invested from that side income for 10 years at 8%? $182,946.
beats.visual: golden hour light hitting an empty road, a single dollar bill pinned under a windshield wiper, close-up

beats.say: But first, you’ve got to separate it. So that money doesn’t vanish into bills or impulse buys.
beats.visual: two separate jars of coins on a windowsill, one labeled 'PAYCHECK', one 'HUSTLE', both backlit by sunset

beats.say: The money rules nobody taught you: separate your side income from day one.
beats.visual: extreme low angle of a skyscraper, a tiny human standing at its base, looking up, fog cutting the skyline

caption:
Your side hustle money deserves its own account. Here’s why and how to do it today.
#SideHustle #MoneyTips #PersonalFinance #Taxes #QuietMoney
